notesStmt.note: This manuscript was likely composed in late 1884 or 1885.

note.p: Drafts lines of "You Tides with Ceaseless Swell," first published along with seven other poems in The Nineteenth Century (August 1885), under the general title "Fancies at Navesink." On the verso is correspondence on the letterhead of Bim M. Jordan, Dry Paints, Pine Wood Products.

notesStmt.note: This is an early draft of "You Tides With Ceaseless Swell," one of eight poems in the "Fancies at Navesink" sequence, which first appeared in print in the August 1885 issue of Nineteenth Century. The sequence was later reprinted in November Boughs (1888).
